title: Humanities
scope: Disciplines that study human culture, history, philosophy, languages, and artistic expression.

title: History
scope: The systematic study and documentation of the human past.

title: Ancient History
scope: History from the beginning of recorded human history to the Early Middle Ages.

title: Medieval History
scope: History of Europe and the Mediterranean from the fall of the Western Roman Empire to the Renaissance.

title: Modern History
scope: History following the Middle Ages from the Early Modern period to contemporary times.

title: Military History
scope: The history of armed conflicts, military strategy, operations, and warfare technology.

title: Historiography
scope: The methodology and history of historical writing and historical research.

title: Languages and Literature
scope: The structure of human language, philology, literary analysis, and comparative literature.

title: Linguistics
scope: The scientific study of human language, phonetics, syntax, semantics, and morphology.

title: Comparative Literature
scope: The study of literature across cultures, time periods, genres, and languages.

title: Philology
scope: The study of language in oral and written historical sources.

title: Literary Theory
scope: Systematic frameworks for interpreting and analyzing literary works.

title: Performing Arts
scope: Arts forms where artists use their voices, bodies, or inanimate objects to convey artistic expression.

title: Music
scope: The art form consisting of sound and silence expressed through rhythm, melody, and harmony.

title: Theatre
scope: Collaborative performing art combining speech, gesture, music, and stagecraft.

title: Dance
scope: Sequences of human movement, often accompanied by music, possessing aesthetic and symbolic value.

title: Visual Arts
scope: Art forms that create works primarily visual in nature, such as ceramics, drawing, painting, sculpture, and design.

title: Drawing and Painting
scope: Practices of applying pigment or graphic marks to surfaces to produce visual compositions.

title: Sculpture
scope: Three-dimensional visual art created through carving, modeling, welding, or casting.

title: Design
scope: The conceptualization, planning, and execution of functional and aesthetic objects and communications.

title: Photography
scope: The art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light.

title: Philosophy
scope: The systematic study of fundamental questions concerning existence, reason, knowledge, values, and mind.

title: Epistemology
scope: The philosophical study of the nature, origin, and limits of human knowledge, justification, and belief.

title: Ethics
scope: Moral philosophy systematizing, defending, and recommending concepts of right and wrong behavior.

title: Philosophical Logic
scope: The systematic study of valid inference, argumentation, and truth structures.

title: Metaphysics
scope: The study of the fundamental nature of reality, existence, ontology, monism, and causality.

title: Ontology
scope: The philosophical branch studying concepts such as existence, being, and reality.

title: Monism and Emanationism
scope: Metaphysical theories holding that reality is fundamentally unified and emanates from a single source.

title: Eastern Philosophy
scope: Philosophical and spiritual traditions originating in South, East, and Southeast Asia.

title: Buddhism
scope: Philosophical and doctrinal traditions centered on liberation, karma, nirvana, and mind.

title: Early Buddhism and Nikaya Studies
scope: The earliest stratum of Buddhist texts, teachings on Attan, Anatta, Citta, and the Nikayas.

title: Theravada Philosophy
scope: The doctrine of the elders, Abhidhamma exegesis, commentary traditions, and monastic practice.

title: Mahayana and Madhyamaka
scope: The Great Vehicle, Nagarjuna's emptiness (Sunyata), two truths, and Bodhisattva ideal.

title: Yogacara Mind-Only
scope: Consciousness-only doctrine, repository consciousness (alayavijnana), and meditative phenomenology.

title: Hindu Philosophy
scope: The six orthodox darshanas, Advaita Vedanta, Samkhya, and Upanishadic metaphysics.

title: Daoism
scope: Chinese philosophical tradition emphasizing living in harmony with the Dao (the Way).

title: Western Philosophy
scope: The philosophical tradition of the Western world from Ancient Greece through Modern and Analytic thought.

title: Religion and Theology
scope: The critical study of religious beliefs, behaviors, institutions, and theological doctrines.

title: Comparative Religion
scope: The systematic comparison of the doctrines and practices of the world's religions.

title: Theology
scope: The systematic study of the nature of the divine and religious truth claims.

title: Social Sciences
scope: Disciplines that study societies, social structures, and human interpersonal relationships.

title: Anthropology
scope: The holistic scientific study of humanity, past and present, across biological, cultural, and linguistic axes.

title: Archaeology
scope: The study of human activity through the recovery and analysis of material culture.

title: Economics
scope: The social science that studies the production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services.

title: Microeconomics
scope: The study of how individual consumers and firms make decisions to allocate scarce resources.

title: Macroeconomics
scope: The study of the economy as a whole, including inflation, national income, growth, and unemployment.

title: Institutional Economics
scope: The study of the role of evolutionary institutions, laws, and norms in shaping economic behavior.

title: Human Geography
scope: The study of the relationships between human communities, cultures, economies, and their spatial environments.

title: Political Science
scope: The scientific study of politics, government systems, political behavior, and public policy.

title: Political Theory
scope: The study of foundational concepts of justice, power, legitimacy, and political philosophy.

title: International Relations
scope: The study of relations between states, international organizations, and transnational actors.

title: Comparative Politics
scope: The systematic analysis of different political systems, regimes, and constitutions.

title: Psychology
scope: The scientific study of mind and behavior, covering perception, cognition, emotion, and personality.

title: Cognitive Psychology
scope: The scientific investigation of mental processes including attention, language, memory, and reasoning.

title: Behavioral Psychology
scope: The study of observable behavior and the environmental stimuli that condition it.

title: Neuropsychology
scope: The study of the structure and function of the brain as they relate to specific psychological processes.

title: Sociology
scope: The scientific study of society, social institutions, social relationships, and social change.

title: Natural Sciences
scope: Disciplines that study the physical and biological world through empirical observation and scientific method.

title: Astronomy
scope: The scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the universe as a physical whole.

title: Astrophysics
scope: The branch of space science that applies the laws of physics and chemistry to explain universe phenomena.

title: Cosmology
scope: The study of the origin, evolution, and ultimate fate of the universe.

title: Biology
scope: The scientific study of life and living organisms, their structure, function, growth, and evolution.

title: Molecular Biology
scope: The study of biological activity at the molecular level, including DNA, RNA, and protein synthesis.

title: Biochemistry
scope: The chemical processes and substances occurring within or relating to living organisms.

title: Genetics
scope: The study of genes, genetic variation, and heredity in organisms.

title: Ecology
scope: The study of interactions among organisms and between organisms and their physical environment.

title: Evolutionary Biology
scope: The subfield of biology that studies the evolutionary processes that produced the diversity of life.

title: Chemistry
scope: The scientific study of the properties, composition, structure, and reactions of matter.

title: Organic Chemistry
scope: The study of the structure, properties, composition, reactions, and preparation of carbon compounds.

title: Inorganic Chemistry
scope: The study of inorganic and organometallic compounds lacking carbon-hydrogen bonds.

title: Physical Chemistry
scope: The study of macroscopic, atomic, and particulate phenomena in chemical systems using physics.

title: Earth Sciences
scope: The fields of science dealing with planet Earth, its atmosphere, oceans, and solid crust.

title: Geology
scope: The scientific study of the Earth's solid materials, rocks, structures, and subterranean processes.

title: Meteorology
scope: The scientific study of the atmosphere with focus on weather forecasting and atmospheric phenomena.

title: Oceanography
scope: The scientific study of physical, chemical, and biological properties of the world ocean.

title: Physics
scope: The foundational science studying matter, motion, energy, force, space, and time.

title: Classical Mechanics
scope: The physical theory describing the motion of macroscopic objects under forces.

title: Quantum Mechanics
scope: The fundamental theory in physics that provides a description of physical properties at atomic scales.

title: Thermodynamics
scope: The branch of physics that deals with heat, work, and temperature, and their relation to energy.

title: Electromagnetism
scope: The branch of physics involving the study of electromagnetic force and electromagnetic fields.

title: Relativity
scope: Einstein's theories of special and general relativity governing space-time and gravity.

title: Formal Sciences
scope: Disciplines concerned with abstract formal systems characterized by axioms, rules, and deductive proof.

title: Computer Science
scope: The study of computation, information processing, algorithms, software, and computational architecture.

title: Algorithms and Complexity
scope: The design, efficiency analysis, and theoretical tractability bounds of computational algorithms.

title: Artificial Intelligence
scope: The theory and development of computer systems able to perform tasks requiring intelligent inference.

title: Operating Systems
scope: System software that manages computer hardware, process execution, memory, and storage resources.

title: Distributed Systems
scope: Systems of independent networked computers communicating and coordinating to solve problems.

title: Cryptography and Security
scope: The practice and study of secure communication, confidentiality, integrity, and cryptographic protocols.

title: Programming Languages and Compilers
scope: The design, semantics, analysis, implementation, and translation of formal programming languages.

title: Mathematics
scope: The abstract science of numbers, quantity, structure, space, and change.

title: Algebra
scope: The study of mathematical symbols and the rules for manipulating these symbols in equations and structures.

title: Mathematical Analysis
scope: The branch of mathematics dealing with continuous change, limits, derivatives, integrals, and series.

title: Geometry and Topology
scope: The study of properties of space, shapes, curvature, and properties invariant under continuous deformations.

title: Number Theory
scope: The branch of pure mathematics devoted primarily to the study of integers and arithmetic properties.

title: Statistics
scope: The discipline that concerns the collection, organization, analysis, interpretation, and presentation of data.

title: Systems Science and Cybernetics
scope: The interdisciplinary field studying the nature of complex systems in nature, society, and science.

title: Cybernetics
scope: The science of communications and automatic control systems in machines and living things.

title: Control Theory
scope: Mathematical subfield dealing with the control of continuously operating dynamical systems.

title: Applied Sciences
scope: Disciplines that apply existing scientific knowledge to practical applications, technology, and professions.

title: Agricultural Sciences
scope: The practice and science of cultivating plants, livestock, and managing biological agricultural systems.

title: Architecture and Built Environment
scope: The art and science of designing and erecting buildings, infrastructure, and urban environments.

title: Business and Management
scope: The operational, organizational, and strategic management of commercial enterprises and institutions.

title: Finance
scope: The management, creation, and study of money, banking, credit, investments, assets, and liabilities.

title: Management
scope: The administration of an organization, coordinating activities and setting strategic direction.

title: Marketing
scope: The study and management of exchange relationships, market demand, and consumer behavior.

title: Education and Pedagogy
scope: The disciplines focused on the methods, theories, and processes of teaching and learning.

title: Engineering and Technology
scope: The application of science and mathematics to design, build, and maintain structures, machines, and systems.

title: Mechanical Engineering
scope: The discipline applying physics and materials science principles to design and manufacture machinery.

title: Electrical Engineering
scope: The discipline that studies and applies electricity, electronics, and electromagnetism.

title: Civil Engineering
scope: The design, construction, and maintenance of the physical and naturally built environment.

title: Chemical Engineering
scope: The branch dealing with the design and operation of plants converting chemicals and materials.

title: Aerospace Engineering
scope: The primary field of engineering concerned with the development of aircraft and spacecraft.

title: Software Engineering
scope: The systematic engineering approach to the development, operation, and maintenance of software.

title: Environmental Studies and Forestry
scope: Interdisciplinary field studying human interaction with the natural environment and resources.

title: Medicine and Health Sciences
scope: The science and practice of caring for patients, managing diagnosis, prognosis, prevention, and treatment.

title: Clinical Medicine
scope: The practice of medicine based on direct observation and treatment of patients.

title: Pharmacology and Therapeutics
scope: The scientific study of drug or medication action and biological systems interaction.

title: Public Health and Epidemiology
scope: The science of protecting and improving the health of people and their communities.

title: Military Sciences
scope: The study of military processes, institutions, behavior, warfare strategy, and defense logistics.

title: Military Strategy and Operational Art
scope: The planning and execution of the operational movement and disposition of forces in war.

title: Military Intelligence and Deception
scope: The collection and analysis of information concerning adversary capabilities and operational deception.

title: Public Administration and Law
scope: The implementation of government policy and the academic study of public governance, law, and civil service.
